missable_note: No confirmed missable list exists yet for a game days old (PlanetGTA6, 18 Nov). The trophies flagged 'possible missable' below are the ones to protect with rotating manual saves: GTA 6 has no mission replay and only 15 manual save slots (games.gg), and Mobalytics names Positive Mental Attitude as the only possible missable found so far.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order (story, then stranger strands, then activities and collectibles, then the 100% cleanup) and this is the last trophy you will hear.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy: play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end. It unlocks naturally and cannot be missed as long as you finish the mission — just follow the on-screen objectives through the opening.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapters unlock in order, so keep playing the main story and this pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish every mission in Chapter 2. The asterisks are in the official name itself. Unmissable while playing through the story.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish every mission in Chapter 3. Keep to the main story path and it pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale — the final mission trophy follows it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy: complete the final mission. After it pops you can keep exploring Leonida in free-roam for as long as you like, and the 100% completion checklist unlocks for the cleanup (Push Square). One of only two golds.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Follow the mission objectives; it pops on completion.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story beats, so this unlocks as you play through — no side work needed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission Child's Play. It pops when the mission ends, as part of the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission Headliners. Story-only; finish the mission and it is yours.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. It pops on mission completion.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. The last named story-mission trophy before the finale — finish the mission and it pops.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold: reach 100% completion. The in-game 100% checklist unlocks when you finish the story (Push Square) — use it as your cleanup list: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and exploration all feed into it. This is the second gold and the real endgame; expect the platinum run to take roughly 200 hours (KeenGamer) to 300+ hours (Push Square).

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver: pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, airtime, near-misses and the like, in any vehicle. Stunts count as you play, so drive fast and jump often from the start; the counter is cumulative, not in one session. Check the in-game stats to see your running total.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once — one taste of everything Leonida offers (races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, drone races, meditation, hunting, bowling and the rest). Dip into each activity the first time you pass it rather than saving them all for the end.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver: earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through the ranges weapon by weapon; gold thresholds are per challenge, so replay a challenge until the score clears gold. Practice with the weapon type first in free-roam, then go for the medal run.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's line before racing for the win — a slow practice lap beats crashing out of a race you could have won. Tick locations off one at a time as you travel.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Enter every race type you find (street, off-road, boat, air) and keep a mental note of which you have won; the count is of distinct races won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are timing and patience: watch the tension, reel steadily, and do not rush the catch. Challenge Cal whenever the fishing activity offers the head-to-head.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game, start to finish. Pick the cabinet you enjoy most — finishing one full game is all it takes, so choose the easiest one you find first and save the harder cabinets for fun.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to his final mission. Stranger and side strands appear as you explore — take Andy's missions whenever they show up and the strand ends with this trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. Work through his jobs in order as they appear; the final one pops this trophy.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. Billy's strand is bike-flavoured — keep his missions in your route as they unlock and finish the last one.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver: complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear all over the map — talk to everyone marked as a stranger, follow each strand to its end, and count your finished strands. The named side strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward the eight.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. Take his jobs as they appear and see the strand through to the end.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. Clear his jobs in order; the final mission closes the strand and pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_reason: Mobalytics names this the only possible missable found so far. Meditation spots may be tied to story moments — meditate at every spot the moment you find it, and keep a rotating manual save.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are scenic points around the state — stop and meditate at each one as you discover it instead of leaving them for the cleanup, since this is the one trophy flagged as possibly missable (Mobalytics).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a specific target, not general hunting — follow his lead to the animal's area, track it quietly, and take the shot when it is clean. A scoped rifle and patience beat a loud approach.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver: complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — pick them up whenever you spot one and keep sets together in your head (or in this tracker's notes). Finishing any three full sets pops it; you do not need every card in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver: use WAiNK It at 100 locations. This is a long grind — use the feature at every new location you visit from the start so the count builds as you play, rather than hunting 100 spots in the cleanup. Your count is cumulative across the whole playthrough.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges are the game's small side goals — accept them as they come and the count grows on its own. Any mix counts, so pick the easy ones first and let the total build up.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missable_reason: Needs your partner present and a 4-star wanted level — do it while partner activities are available, and keep a manual save before you try.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Plan the escape before you start: a fast car stashed nearby, a route out of the search area, and somewhere to break line of sight. Lose the heat with your partner still with you.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missable_reason: Needs your partner present for three robberies in a row — do it while partner activities are available, and keep a manual save before you try.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level — the level must stay up through all three. Pick three shops close together, plan a fast route between them, and do not let the cops drop: keep moving and keep the heat on until the third robbery is done.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get in, or get close to, 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Variety is the point: try every car, bike, boat and aircraft you see rather than sticking to one favourite. The count is of distinct vehicles discovered.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up: find a spot with five or more enemies grouped together, trigger Combat Focus with a weapon you can sweep quickly, and chain the takedowns before the effect ends. A busy shootout is the natural place to try it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missable_reason: A one-off stunt at the airport — save manually before you attempt it, in case the moment only comes once.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — leave VCIA by a way the airport did not schedule. Get a plane (or a fast vehicle) and take off from the airport on your own terms. Save manually first: this reads like a one-shot stunt, so do not attempt it with only an autosave behind you.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhinos — the tanks. Get into a Rhino tank (or deal with them at high wanted levels) and the trophy follows the tank moment. Build a big wanted level if no Rhino shows up on its own.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missable_reason: Undetected means one clean run — a failed attempt may raise the alarm, so save manually right before you go in.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: case the store first, move when staff and cameras look away, take the goods and leave before anyone notices. Save manually right before the attempt so a blown run costs you nothing.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver: rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Vaults are the big robberies — plan the getaway before the break-in, and count only the vaults you escape cleanly. Five successful vault jobs, not five attempts.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida — stop one, crack it, take the cash and get clear before the response arrives. A roadblock or a sticky bomb beats chasing it for miles.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel — drive, fly and sail into every corner of the state, including the small towns and islands, not just Vice City. Use the map's area counter to find the gaps at the end.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own operations — find each gang's turf, hit one operation per gang, and keep a list of which gangs you have done. Nine gangs, nine hits.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar or spot with a sea view on Ocean Beach, order the cocktail and take in the view — a quiet moment trophy, and a good one to grab early for the mood.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass, the old-school way. Pick a showroom, line up a fast car, and go through the front.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — bowl a proper game there. Head to the Kolt & Associates alley, play through a game, and follow through on your throws. A nod to the old games, and an easy bronze.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Secret trophy — the official description is deliberately vague ('a partnership with mass appeal'). It is tied to a partnership moment in the game: keep playing with your partner, follow the partnership storyline, and it unlocks when the moment lands. No extra grind is described; it comes from the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable_reason: Choice-based: the description counts choices made, and PSN is said to track a count toward 500. Choices cannot be replayed (no mission replay, games.gg), so make choices deliberately and keep rotating manual saves.
trophies.guide: Secret trophy — 'choices made (for better or worse)'. It tracks choices you make through the game, with PSN counting toward 500 choices. Play normally and choose deliberately at every decision point; because there is no mission replay (games.gg), keep rotating manual saves so a choice you regret does not cost the run.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missable_reason: 'Second time's the charm' points to a retry — failing once, then succeeding. If the trigger moment is one-off, keep a manual save before attempts that feel retryable.
trophies.guide: Secret trophy — 'second time's the charm'. It reads as a trophy for succeeding on a second try after a failure, so when a mission or challenge beats you, go straight back in and clear it on the retry. Keep a manual save before tricky moments in case the trigger only fires once.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missable_reason: A strange, possibly one-time event ('what the hell just happened?'). Explore odd places and keep a manual save when something weird is about to happen.
trophies.guide: Secret trophy — 'what the hell just happened?' It points to a strange, unexplained event somewhere in Leonida. Explore the odd corners of the map, investigate anything out of place, and keep a manual save handy when something weird starts — one-time events do not come back.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Secret trophy — knock someone down with a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, strike a target with a melee weapon. Line up a slow pass past a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and keep the vehicle moving. Practice the timing on a quiet street first.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — funnel them through your laundering contacts steadily instead of sitting on them, and the $250,000 total builds up. It is cumulative across the playthrough.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything the shops sell. Spend normally through the game and the total climbs; if you are short at the end, buy ammo and supplies in bulk. Cumulative spend, all shops combined.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought around Leonida as you earn money — buy each one when you can afford it, since they also store the vehicles you collect for Whip It Good. The last garage you buy pops the trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one — ten different vehicles registered pops it. Combine this with the 100-vehicle discovery hunt for Whip It Good.

roadmap.title: Play the story, spoiler shield on
roadmap.text: Start with the story and leave the spoiler shield ON — the 12 story trophies (opening mission, 4 chapters, final mission, 6 named missions) unlock naturally. Finish the story first: it unlocks the 100% checklist (Push Square) and free-roam, and everything else is easier with the whole map open. Estimated: the main story is the first big block of the 200–300 hour platinum run.

roadmap.title: Stranger strands & side missions
roadmap.text: Clear the stranger strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret's hunt, and 8 stranger strands in total for the silver Strangers & Freaks. Talk to every stranger you pass — strands unlock as you explore, and finishing them early keeps the map clean for later.

roadmap.title: Activities & skills
roadmap.text: Work the activities: 250 stunts, 42 Shooting Range golds (silver), 14 drone-race wins, 20 race wins, fishing vs Cal, one arcade game, 50 challenges, and bowling at Kolt & Associates. Try each of the 9 activity types once for Master of None. Do stunts and races as you travel instead of grinding them at the end.

roadmap.title: Collectibles & exploration
roadmap.text: Sweep the map: meditate at all 18 spots (do these as you find them — the one possible missable), 3 card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, all 52 areas explored, 8 garages bought, 10 vehicles on Scooter Bros. Collect as you go; the counts are cumulative.

roadmap.title: Combat, chaos & money
roadmap.text: Combat and money trophies: 5 takedowns in one Combat Focus, 5 bank vaults (silver), armored truck, one illegal operation per gang (9 gangs), the partner robberies, the VCIA departure, the jewelry store, the showroom smash and the Ocean Beach cocktail, the secret choice/event trophies — and the money: launder $250,000 in Marked Bills, spend $100,000 in shops. Keep rotating manual saves here: no mission replay, 15 manual slots (games.gg).

roadmap.title: 100% cleanup → platinum
roadmap.text: Finish with the 100% checklist (unlocked after the story) and A Long Road, the second gold. When the checklist hits 100%, the gold pops — and with it, the platinum Vice Got a Price! Expect roughly 200 hours (KeenGamer) to 300+ hours (Push Square) for the full run, all offline, in a single playthrough.
